verdict.rationale: Feitian's docs show the keys carry a PIV function managed through SK Manager, with guides for macOS PIV smart-card logon and PIV digital signatures, so certificate-based workstation sign-in and signing are covered at a basic level. The evidence is only short guide titles: there is nothing on VPN use, Windows or AD smart-card logon via PIV, or code signing specifically. missing for 10: VPN certificate auth, Windows smart-card logon via PIV, explicit code-signing workflow, statement that private keys are generated and kept on-device and cannot be exported, in-depth docs and independent or hands-on corroboration.
